data.name: Escape to the Italian brainrot
data.detailed_description:
Escape to the Italian Brainrot is an absurd horror game about trying to escape a strange village inhabited by Italian brainrot characters.

Explore the village, find useful items, and discover who needs them. The locals may ask you to bring them completely ridiculous things — from a jar of pickles to a car battery. Complete their requests, trade items, and gradually unlock your way to freedom.

But be careful: not everyone in the village wants to help you.

🧩 Find Your Way Out

There are multiple ways to escape the village. One character might open a path for you, another may require you to complete a long chain of strange requests, while someone else might simply be the only thing standing between you and freedom.

🥒 Help the Brainrot

Everyone has a problem.

  • Bring Tung Tung Tung Sahur a bat.

  • Find a jar of pickles for a very strange pickle.

  • Get a car battery and some money for a suspicious trader.

  • Trade bread for something you actually need.

  • Complete quest chains and unlock new ways to escape.

🏚️ Explore the Village

Search abandoned buildings, explore strange locations, and investigate the most suspicious places in the village.

Not everything you need will be lying around in plain sight. Sometimes you'll first have to figure out who needs it — and why.

👥 Play With Friends

Explore the village with a friend and work together to complete quests.

One player can search for an item while the other deals with the next brainrot character. And when things go wrong, at least you'll have someone to run away with.

🕯️ Retro Horror Atmosphere

  • PSX-inspired visuals

  • Minimalist interface

  • Dark and strange atmosphere

  • Absurd humor

  • Unexpected encounters

  • Multiple ways to escape

You came here to escape.
Now you just have to figure out what you need to open the door.
